To assure compliance with the Wisconsin Environmental Policy
Act a public hearing was held on July 11, 1974 for the environmental
consideration of the Airport Spur freeway proposal. This hearing
provided an opportunity for additional citizen and agency views
as to the social, economic and environmental aspects of the Airport
Spur. The same corridor locations proposed at the March 25, 1969
location hearing were presented. Section XI of this Final EIS contains
a compendium of the official testimony, oral and written, taken
at the 1974 public hearing.
